skill.name: socialdatax-content-calendar-research
skill.description: Research social content calendars using SocialDataX hot lists and keyword searches across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou.
skill.summary: Collect platform trends and content samples to inform seven-day or thirty-day topic planning.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts concern Markdown, Chinese prose, ordinary service links, or expected API authentication; no evidence found of embedded secrets or malicious prompt overrides. The command block executes an unpinned npm package, exposing the host and available credentials to changing third-party code. A separate instruction requires forwarding token-bearing XHS URLs without redaction, creating a potential disclosure risk.

remediation.issue: Direct commands execute socialdatax-skills@latest with automatic npm approval.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify its provenance, and obtain execution approval before giving the package access to service credentials.

remediation.issue: XHS output instructions require preserving xsec_token in all displays, storage, and forwarding.
remediation.suggestion: Keep necessary signed URLs within authorized destinations. Remove blanket anti-redaction instructions and obtain consent before sharing token-bearing links outside the research context.

content.user_title: Research Social Content Calendars with SocialDataX
content.value_statement: Content planning requires current trends and relevant examples across several platforms. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and organizes evidence for Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou topic planning.
actual_capabilities: Guide retrieval of current platform hot lists through the SocialDataX CLI or already configured MCP tools.
Search Xiaohongshu notes and Douyin or Kuaishou content using focused keywords.
Apply documented Xiaohongshu and Douyin sorting, publication-time, and content-type filters.
Limit search collection with page counts and item caps, then continue using returned pagination tokens.
Organize rankings, content samples, identifiers, authors, and available metrics while separating observations from interpretation.
Preserve partial results and resume interrupted searches within the original collection limits.
limitations: Live retrieval requires a configured SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY, network access, and sufficient SocialDataX balance.
Direct execution requires Node.js and npm; the supplied package commands use an unpinned latest version.
Search results are samples, not exhaustive coverage or proof of optimal posting times.
The skill does not publish posts, schedule deliveries, or provide a dedicated calendar export workflow.

use_cases.title: Prepare a weekly topic shortlist
use_cases.description: Review Xiaohongshu trends and keyword samples to choose topics for a seven-day editorial plan.

use_cases.title: Compare content signals across platforms
use_cases.description: Separate hot-list rankings from keyword results when comparing relevant topics on Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou.

use_cases.description: Collect bounded content samples, group related angles, and retain useful identifiers for a thirty-day planning discussion.

prompt_templates.title: Review one platform
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current Xiaohongshu hot list for [topic]. Separate visible ranking signals from your interpretation and suggest three research angles.

prompt_templates.title: Collect a focused sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Xiaohongshu for [keyword] from the past week. Start with one page, cap collection at 20 items, and summarize recurring angles.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: gather a bounded keyword sample.

prompt_templates.title: Compare platform evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [topic] across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou using one hot list and one search page per platform. Separate evidence, interpretations, and gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare signals without assuming identical filters.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a monthly planning brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] for a thirty-day planning brief. Cap searches at two pages and 30 items per platform. Group angles and flag incomplete results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: organize research for editorial planning, not automatic publishing.

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative weekly research summary for home organization on Xiaohongshu.
output: Illustrative format only; no live results are claimed.
Evidence: list returned titles, authors, content identifiers, and available publication dates.
Topic groups: small-space storage, maintenance routines, and product comparisons.
Planning notes: assign candidate angles to a seven-day draft and mark assumptions requiring validation.

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative comparison brief when a Douyin search returns partial results.
output: Illustrative format only; no live results are claimed.
Xiaohongshu: summarize hot-list signals separately from keyword samples.
Douyin: retain collected samples and report that the response was partial.
Kuaishou: summarize available titles, authors, and engagement fields.
Next step: resume only with a valid continuation token and the remaining collection allowance.

best_practices: Start with one page and explicit item limits before expanding a search.
Keep hot-list signals, search observations, and editorial judgments separate.
Review package execution and destination permissions before using credentials or sharing token-bearing links.
anti_patterns: Treating a small search sample as complete market coverage or a proven posting schedule.
Restarting partial searches from page one without accounting for collected items and request limits.
Sharing API keys or token-bearing URLs in public reports without reviewing recipient access.

faq.question: Which platforms are covered?
faq.answer: The instructions cover Xiaohongshu, also called XHS or RedNote, Douyin, and Kuaishou.

faq.question: What is required for live research?
faq.answer: Configure a SocialDataX API key and ensure network access and sufficient balance. Direct CLI execution also requires Node.js and npm.

faq.question: Must I configure an MCP server?
faq.answer: No. The skill prefers direct CLI commands and also documents matching MCP tools when they are already available.

faq.question: Can this skill publish or schedule posts?
faq.answer: No. The documented scope is read-only research, without login, posting, likes, comments, or account changes.

faq.question: Does it find the best posting time?
faq.answer: No. Available publication timestamps can support observations, but the instructions do not establish causal timing analysis or guaranteed performance.

faq.question: What happens when results are incomplete?
faq.answer: Keep partial samples and disclose the gap. Resume with a valid continuation token while preserving the original page and item limits.
